lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: I see a thick red scaly patch on your right knee, for six months.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Apply calcipotriol ointment once a day for four weeks.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Finish all four weeks, even if it improves.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: It itches, but it does not bleed.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Should I cover it with a bandage?
